## Change / 修改内容

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility or data implications.

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior or configuration.
- [ ] Tests and examples use temporary directories and synthetic data.
- [ ] No credentials, personal memory, chat history, runtime copies, or local artifacts are included.

For host integration changes, record the bundled runtime version and distinguish
unit tests, runtime smoke, native UI verification, and real model calls.
